const url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasonbitsmith/muse-skills/main/README.md";
const cfg = { url: url, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const pu=new URL(cfg.url);",
  "http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:cfg.url,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/131'}},function(res){",
  "  const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "  res.on('end',function(){",
  "    const s=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "    const fs=require('fs');",
  "    fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-muse.md', s);",
  "    // find all <summary> titles",
  "    const re=/<summary><b>([^<]+)<\\/b><\\/summary>/g;",
  "    let m, titles=[];",
  "    while((m=re.exec(s))!==null){ titles.push(m[1]); }",
  "    console.log('TOTAL ENTRIES:', titles.length);",
  "    // keyword filter",
  "    const kw=['学生','校园','大学','考研','论文','作业','答辩','毕业','宿舍','社团','班','上课','课表','考试','复习','实习','求职','简历','室友','助学','奖学金','宿舍','教材','四六级','考公','留学','文书','小组'];",
  "    const hits=titles.filter(t=>kw.some(k=>t.indexOf(k)>=0));",
  "    console.log('MATCHED:', hits.length);",
  "    console.log(hits.join('\\n'));",
  "  });",
  "});",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-d3.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-d3.cjs";
